dataset_or_service: OpenStreetMap database used as basemap data
access_model: Public web tiles consumed by browser; data licensed ODbL
allowed_product_claims: Display OSM-derived basemaps with ODbL notice; distribute derivative databases under ODbL
prohibited_product_claims: Imply OSMF endorsement; redistribute an OSM-derived database under a closed licence
notes: Data is ODbL: attribution plus share-alike for derivative databases; rendered Produced Works need attribution only. OSMF tile hosting is a separate service (MD-02) and is not licensed by the data licence.

dataset_or_service: tile.openstreetmap.org standard raster tiles
access_model: Free community tile service; browser requests to public endpoint
service_level_restrictions: Best-effort only; no SLA; access may be blocked or withdrawn without notice; commercial services may lose access
allowed_product_claims: Normal interactive viewing with visible attribution and an identifiable client
prohibited_product_claims: Bulk download or prefetch; offline maps or save-area features; tile archives (.mbtiles/.zip); pre-seeding zoom stacks; unidentified caching proxy; no-cache headers; masquerading User-Agent
notes: Service-worker dataGroups cache (10,000 tiles / 7 days) is passive viewport caching, permitted if cache headers are honoured; it must never become a prefetch or offline-basemap feature. Tile access can be withdrawn from commercial products, so a self-hosted or licensed provider is required for a paid MAREA service.

dataset_or_service: OpenSeaMap seamark overlay tiles (tiles.openseamap.org)
access_model: Public tile overlay; ODbL data rendered as CC BY-SA 2.0 tiles
service_level_restrictions: No published SLA or tile usage policy located
allowed_product_claims: Seamark overlay display with OpenSeaMap attribution
prohibited_product_claims: Bulk-caching the public tile endpoint; presenting seamarks as official or survey-grade aids
notes: Data is ODbL; rendered tiles are CC BY-SA 2.0. No official tile usage policy was found, so caching and offline use stay LEGAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED. The repo already forbids bulk-downloading this endpoint (docs/CHARTS.md:62,176) - keep that rule.

dataset_or_service: EMODnet Bathymetry DTM 2024 via WMS/WCS (ows.emodnet-bathymetry.eu) and rendered tiles
access_model: Open WMS/WCS and DTM download; no account
service_level_restrictions: Best effort; no SLA; service under development
allowed_product_claims: Bathymetry context, depth shading and coastal mask; cite EMODnet and the product CC BY 4.0
prohibited_product_claims: Nautical chart, official chart, navigation-grade or safety-of-navigation claim; imply EU endorsement
notes: EMODnet-created data products are EU-owned and CC BY 4.0. Underlying originator datasets may carry their own restrictions (check per-dataset metadata). The cached 916-tile Ria de Vigo package (docs/CHARTS.md:178) must keep EMODnet/EU CC BY 4.0 attribution and the dataset version.

dataset_or_service: IBI analysis/forecast physics and waves (cmems_mod_ibi_phy_anfc_*, cmems_mod_ibi_wav_anfc_*)
access_model: Free account plus Copernicus Marine Toolbox; server-side session
rate_limits: Service-managed sessions; no published per-user call quota
service_level_restrictions: Portal availability 97% per year; products as-is without warranty
allowed_product_claims: Forecast/analysis display and derived route or sea-state context credited as Generated using E.U. Copernicus Marine Service Information plus DOIs
prohibited_product_claims: Warranty of accuracy; claim E.U. or Mercator Ocean endorsement; omit DOI or credit; navigation-grade claim
notes: Licence grants worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free, perpetual rights to copy, modify, create derivative and value-added products, and redistribute originals for any purpose. Mandatory credit wording and DOI citation (2.4), records of use (2.6), licence may be revised. Service free until end of programme (planned 2028).

dataset_or_service: GEBCO global bathymetry grid via WMS (wms.gebco.net) and rendered tiles
access_model: Open WMS; public-domain grid
allowed_product_claims: Contextual bathymetry and fallback display with GEBCO acknowledgement
prohibited_product_claims: Use for navigation or safety at sea (explicitly prohibited); official or endorsed status; accuracy claim
notes: Public domain; commercial exploitation explicitly allowed with acknowledgement. The repo already labels GEBCO not suitable for navigation (package-planner.service.ts:56); the GEBCO disclaimer must be preserved in UI and docs.

dataset_or_service: NOAA ENC S-57 cells and NOAA Chart Display WMS
access_model: Open download and WMS; US federal public domain
service_level_restrictions: WMS availability and rate terms not stated
allowed_product_claims: US-waters official NOAA chart display with NOAA attribution and chart edition date
prohibited_product_claims: Use as official chart for Spain or Portugal; NOAA endorsement; navigation outside US coverage; EU/ES official-status claim
notes: ENC data are US Government works (public domain), but the NOAA terms page was not retrievable in this audit and the Chart Display WMS service terms are unverified. Out of MAREA's ES/PT market scope; keep only as an optional user-selected layer.

provider: Instituto Hidrografico de la Marina (IHM) / IC-ENC
dataset_or_service: IHM official ENC exchange sets (S-63 encrypted, S-57 cells)
access_model: Purchase of exchange sets and cell permits through IC-ENC authorised distributors; S-63 OEM identity required
rate_limits: Per distributor EULA and IC-ENC supply terms
allowed_product_claims: No official navigation claim until a valid EULA and permits exist; recreational ECS, not ECDIS
prohibited_product_claims: Redistribute or sublicense ENC; embed in hardware without distributor/OEM agreement; bypass S-63 encryption; claim ECDIS or type approval
notes: Official navigation-grade source for Spanish waters, but MAREA holds no IC-ENC distributor or OEM agreement. S-63 EULA terms are per distributor and were not verified. NAV must not ship or advertise official ENC until a distribution agreement exists.

dataset_or_service: IHM RasterENC WMTS display service (ideihm.covam.es/ihmcache/wmts) and ENC WMS
access_model: Open WMTS/WMS display; no account
service_level_restrictions: No SLA; IHM may change or withdraw the service
allowed_product_claims: Online reference layer with IHM attribution and an explicit not-valid-for-official-navigation label
prohibited_product_claims: Caching, offline packaging or redistribution; official or navigation-grade claim; removing the IHM disclaimer
notes: IHM states the service is not valid for navigation and is a basemap for its own mobile app; no licence text for caching or derived products is published. The repo currently forbids caching IHM (docs/CHARTS.md:180) - keep it online-only until written terms are obtained.

dataset_or_service: IHM tide predictions JSON API (Anuario de Mareas, api-ihm/getmarea)
access_model: Public JSON API intended for embedding tide predictions
service_level_restrictions: No SLA or published rate limit
allowed_product_claims: Official tide predictions with IHM attribution, date and time, and predictions-not-observed labelling
prohibited_product_claims: Alter prediction values; apply them to charted soundings; navigation guarantee; claim observed levels
notes: IHM documents the API for embedding tide predictions in web pages, which supports display, but redistribution and caching terms are not stated. The engine caches predictions for 6 hours (server.ts:165-170); keep attribution and freshness and seek written confirmation before bundling.

dataset_or_service: MBAR24 high-resolution bathymetric model (CNIG/IHM download centre)
access_model: Registration, licence acceptance and stated purpose at cihm.cnig.es
allowed_product_claims: NO
prohibited_product_claims: Non-commercial use only with the exact attribution string MBAR24 [date] CC-BY-NC 4.0 ihm.es; no navigation-safety use
notes: Official licence is CC-BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial only) and forbids navigation-safety use. The repository label CC BY 4.0 (chart-source-catalog.ts:154; package-planner.service.ts:146) is wrong and must be corrected before any commercial MAREA claim or bundle.

dataset_or_service: IHM/INSPIRE coastline WFS and IHM coastline WMS/WFS layers
access_model: Open WFS/WMS or CNIG shapefile download
allowed_product_claims: Coastline display with IHM attribution once the applicable licence is confirmed
prohibited_product_claims: Treat as CC BY 4.0 without confirming the licence; use as authoritative chart source; navigation-grade claim
notes: The repo labels this CC BY 4.0 but no IHM licence page for the INSPIRE coastline was found. INSPIRE/LISIGE publication alone does not grant commercial reuse; confirm the dataset licence (IHM service vs CNIG download) in writing.

dataset_or_service: IGN/CNIG geographic data downloads (BTN, MDT, coastline shapefiles from centrodedescargas.cnig.es)
access_model: Free download; registration for some products
rate_limits: Portal limits; no published rate policy
allowed_product_claims: Reuse with IGN/CNIG attribution, update date and modification notice; compatible with CC BY 4.0 under Orden FOM/2807/2015
prohibited_product_claims: Suggest IGN endorsement; omit attribution or modification notice; use as an official nautical chart
notes: The IGN/CNIG licence (Orden FOM/2807/2015) is stated by CNIG to be CC BY 4.0-compatible. The licence PDF could not be downloaded in this audit environment; verify the current text and per-product conditions before shipping. It does not cover IHM MBAR (see MD-11).

dataset_or_service: CartoCiudad geocoder REST API (candidates and find endpoints)
access_model: Public geocoding API; no account
service_level_restrictions: No SLA; a usage policy exists in CNIG service documentation
allowed_product_claims: Place-search results with CartoCiudad attribution and no cadastral references
prohibited_product_claims: Bulk geocoding or scraping; expose cadastral information; imply IGN endorsement
notes: The engine caches area-search results locally (config.ts:93). CartoCiudad terms require attribution and exclude catastral references from derived products; the service usage policy was not fetched and must be confirmed for a commercial HUB/NAV feature.

dataset_or_service: Open-Meteo free forecast, marine and wind APIs (api.open-meteo.com, marine-api.open-meteo.com)
access_model: Free HTTPS JSON API without key; paid plans for commercial use
service_level_restrictions: 600 calls/min, 5,000/hour, 10,000/day, 300,000/month on free tier; no uptime guarantee; paid 99.9% target
allowed_product_claims: Weather and marine forecast display with Weather data by Open-Meteo.com and CC BY 4.0 attribution
prohibited_product_claims: Commercial use of the free API; reselling API access; ECMWF/DWD/Meteo-France endorsement; accuracy guarantee
notes: Data is CC BY 4.0 (attribution required, modification allowed) but the free API is explicitly non-commercial. MAREA subscriptions require an Open-Meteo commercial subscription (customer-api.open-meteo.com plus key) or self-hosting the AGPLv3 server. Upstream model licences (ECMWF, DWD, Meteo-France) may add conditions to redistributed model output.

dataset_or_service: AEMET OpenData datasets (observations, climatologies)
access_model: AEMET OpenData API with key; reuse authorisation
allowed_product_claims: Reuse of open AEMET datasets credited as (c) AEMET or Informacion elaborada por la Agencia Estatal de Meteorologia, with update date
prohibited_product_claims: Distort the data; imply AEMET sponsorship; present as an endorsed forecast product
notes: The Nota Legal authorises commercial and non-commercial reuse of covered documents with attribution, immutable technical content and update-date citation. It applies only to datasets actually published as open data - not to NWP output (see MD-17).

dataset_or_service: AEMET HARMONIE-AROME numerical weather prediction output
access_model: Not exposed via AEMET OpenData; request or agreement required
allowed_product_claims: None until a written data-supply agreement exists
prohibited_product_claims: Any forecast claim without a written data-supply agreement; imply AEMET endorsement
notes: The official AEMET FAQ (item 4.2) states that numerical model outputs are not considered open data and must be requested through AEMET channels. The FAQ PDF could not be downloaded in this audit (content confirmed through the official FAQ index); treat NWP as unavailable to MAREA unless an agreement is signed.

dataset_or_service: MeteoGalicia WRF forecast data (THREDDS/OPeNDAP/WMS) and tide RSS feed
access_model: Open THREDDS/OPeNDAP/WMS and RSS; no credential advertised
service_level_restrictions: No SLA; catalogue returned HTTP 502 during the earlier audit
allowed_product_claims: Galicia-only coastal forecast and tide display with MeteoGalicia/Xunta attribution once terms are confirmed
prohibited_product_claims: Redistribution or bundled sale of MeteoGalicia model output; official forecast claim; imply Xunta endorsement
notes: The MeteoGalicia legal notice could not be retrieved (HTTP 404 via audit fetch) and the repo itself flags confirm dataset terms before redistribution. The tides RSS feed is already used in code, so terms confirmation is a priority for WEATHER and NAV.

provider: Puertos del Estado (with Intecmar and IH Portugal)
dataset_or_service: HF radar surface currents (opendap.puertos.es THREDDS) and PORTUS/Portuscopia forecast products
access_model: Open THREDDS/OPeNDAP/NCSS/WMS; no auth
service_level_restrictions: Portuscopia viewer and recurrent downloads documented; no SLA
allowed_product_claims: Current and wave observation/forecast display with Puertos del Estado, Intecmar and IH attribution
prohibited_product_claims: Third-party transfer without authorization; redistribution of PORTUS products; navigation-grade claim
notes: Puertos open-data reuse follows the RISP plan (attribution, no distortion, no endorsement), but the aviso legal timed out and the HF radar dataset distribution statement (free of charge, use at own risk) is recorded only in repo code. Repo docs also note the official FAQ discourages third-party transfer - confirm in writing.

dataset_or_service: OpenWeather current/forecast API and Weather Maps 2.0 tile layers (tile.openweathermap.org)
access_model: API key; self-service paid plans; Weather Maps 2.0 sold separately
allowed_product_claims: Weather layers with Weather data (c) OpenWeatherMap under a paid plan
prohibited_product_claims: Free-tier commercial use; sublicense or resell the original service; imply OpenWeather endorsement of MAREA
notes: Weather Maps 2.0 tile layers are a separate paid product (450 GBP/month on the published price list); a standard API key used for tile endpoints is not covered. The licence explainer allows commercial derivative products with attribution but not sublicensing or reselling the original solution. The engine caches tiles 30 minutes (server.ts:203) - confirm caching terms.

dataset_or_service: Esri World Imagery satellite basemap tiles (server.arcgisonline.com)
access_model: Direct tile URL hardcoded in the UI; no ArcGIS account or key
authentication_required: NO for the direct tile URL
allowed_product_claims: Satellite basemap display only if covered by Esri terms and the official attribution string
prohibited_product_claims: Offline packaging or redistribution of imagery; claiming imagery ownership; navigation use of satellite imagery
notes: Tiles are fetched directly from server.arcgisonline.com with no ArcGIS Online subscription, which is not a documented licensed access path for a commercial product. Keep the layer disabled or obtain an Esri/ArcGIS agreement and use the official attribution string.

dataset_or_service: MapLibre GL JS renderer, MapLibre demo tiles and demo fonts
access_model: npm package; demo tile and glyph endpoints without key
rate_limits: Demo tile server limits; no SLA
service_level_restrictions: Demo tiles are for development only
allowed_product_claims: Ship MapLibre under BSD-3-Clause with its copyright notice
prohibited_product_claims: Rely on demotiles.maplibre.org demo tiles or fonts in production; imply MapLibre endorsement; treat the renderer licence as a data licence
notes: The software licence is permissive (BSD-3-Clause). Demo tiles and glyph endpoints are development-only with no SLA and must be replaced by licensed or self-hosted tiles and glyphs before production; the renderer grants no tile or data rights.

dataset_or_service: Signal K server (signalk/signalk-server) and Signal K data model used for own-vessel data
access_model: Local Docker service; open source
allowed_product_claims: Ship and connect the Signal K server under Apache-2.0 with notices
prohibited_product_claims: Claim certification or approval; present own-vessel data as third-party licensed data; publish other vessels data without a legal basis
notes: Server code is Apache-2.0 and the specification is CC-BY-SA. The data processed is the customer's own vessel telemetry, so no third-party data right is implied; FLEET sharing of vessel positions is a separate privacy and contract question, not a Signal K licence one.

provider: AIS reception via RTL-SDR and AIS-catcher (receive-only)
dataset_or_service: AIS VHF broadcast messages received onboard (ITU-R M.1371) and AIS-derived target/traffic data
access_model: Receive-only VHF broadcast; no account; local UDP to Signal K
service_level_restrictions: No SLA; reception range and quality are physical limits
allowed_product_claims: Receive-only AIS for own-vessel situational awareness with target age and receiver source shown
prohibited_product_claims: Claim an official or authority-grade AIS traffic service; redistribute or resell aggregated AIS traffic without a legal basis; alter AIS content
notes: ITU-R M.1371 defines AIS as a broadcast standard but grants no data-reuse rights. Local reception for own navigation awareness is the documented posture; redistribution or FLEET-level sharing of AIS-derived traffic needs specific legal review (privacy and coastal-authority rules). AIS-catcher is an external GPL tool installed by scripts/init.sh, not vendored in the audited tree.

dataset_or_service: NMEA sentences from GPS, wind, IMU and depth sensors processed by the gateway
access_model: Owned hardware and own data; no provider terms
allowed_product_claims: Process and display the customer's own instrument data
prohibited_product_claims: Claim NMEA 2000 certification or NMEA compliance without authorization; redistribute customer data without consent
notes: Own-vessel sensor data creates no third-party data right. NMEA 0183/2000 protocol licensing, manufacturer codes and certification are out of this matrix scope (protocol licensing audited separately); do not claim NMEA 2000 Certified without authorization.

dataset_or_service: MBTiles, GeoTIFF/KAP and open S-57 or S-63 chart files imported by the customer
access_model: Manual import or upload of files the customer is licensed to use
modified_data: CONDITIONAL (only if the chart EULA permits conversion)
allowed_product_claims: Import and display the customer's own licensed charts offline on their own device
prohibited_product_claims: Bundle, redistribute or resell imported charts; convert licensed charts for sharing; bypass S-63 or other encryption
notes: The import-only model keeps redistribution responsibility with the user, but converting licensed charts to MBTiles may itself breach the chart EULA. The repo explicitly excludes S-63 bypass, oeSENC and commercial decryption (docs/CHARTS.md:16-22,188-190); keep it that way.

provider: Official hydrographic offices (IHM Spain, IHPT Portugal) via IC-ENC
dataset_or_service: Official navigation-grade ENC licensing requirement for the NAV product
access_model: Distributor agreement, OEM registration, cell permits and end-user EULA
allowed_product_claims: No official chart claim until licensed; recreational ECS, not ECDIS disclaimer
prohibited_product_claims: Official charts, ECDIS, type approval or navigation-grade claims without licensed ENC and permits; free or bundled official charts
notes: NAV's honest position today is licensed-chart-capable but not licensed. Any MAREA promise of included official charts, offline official regions or ECDIS-like status is blocked until IC-ENC/IHM/IHPT distributor terms and S-63 OEM status exist.

dataset_or_service: Natural Earth 1:10m/1:50m/1:110m raster and vector base map data (candidate)
evidence_repo_refs: not referenced in open-marine @403941b (grep: no matches); proposed candidate
access_model: Free download; public domain
allowed_product_claims: Use for land and context basemap, optionally Made with Natural Earth
prohibited_product_claims: Present as survey-grade or navigation data; imply endorsement
notes: Public domain, commercial use explicitly allowed, no attribution required. Not currently integrated in the repository; a viable no-royalty land basemap to replace OSM or Esri dependencies where only coastline and land context is needed.
